C0.loc: Abstract, p. 397; Section 1, pp. 397-398; Section 5, p. 414
C0.quote: characterizes the Shapley value (the Shapley–Shubik power index) on the domain
C0.note: The main object is a value or power index for cooperative TU games and simple games. It allocates surplus or measures players' a priori voting power. It does not aggregate agents' inputs into a collective decision by voting, and it does not study strategic or computational aspects of such a procedure. Simple games appear only as representations of voting systems whose power distribution is measured. This is an axiomatic cooperative game theory and fair-allocation paper, so coding stops at C0.
